releases.notes:
# LiLaC 1.0.0-beta.3

## What's new since 1.0.0-beta.2

* Added support for Minecraft 1.20.2
* Added API to create DataResult in DFU (got upgraded with Minecraft 1.20.2, and introduced a breaking change)

## About this release

* Last 1.0.0 beta
* The next version will be 1.0.1-beta.1
  * Not all planned Minecraft versions are supported yet
  * To properly test older versions using OptiGUI, new APIs needed by OptiGUI will be added

## Recommendations

* This is a snapshot release before adding support for older Minecraft versions
* OptiGUI will depend on the next version, and not on this
* Documentation is available on [GitHub Pages](https://opekope2.github.io/LiLaC)

# LiLaC 1.0.0-beta.2

## What's new since 1.0.0-beta.2

* Fixed a crash when loading resources
  * Probably caused by an incompatible mod

## About this release

* This is a hotfix release for 2.0.0-beta.1
* Also first GitHub CI test

## Recommendations

* Recommended to update from 2.0.0-beta.1
* WIP documentation is available on [GitHub Pages](https://opekope2.github.io/LiLaC)

readmeSummary: LiLaC aimed to provide a common API for different Minecraft versions, helping OptiGUI supporting multiple versions of the game.
